answer_1.quote: The goal is to change the text style, such as formality, and politeness with preserving the sense of the input text. ... we propose a simple but effective reframing model for the PTR task...
answer_1.outputs: Positive reframed sentences generated from input texts

answer_2.quote: we used the eight metrics, which are (1) ROUGE-1, -2, -LCS (longest common subsequence) , BLUE and BERT-Score referring to the gold reference for assessing the performance on content preservation, (2) The ∆TextBlob value for assessing the positivity transfer effectiveness, and (3) The Average Length and Perplexity, followed by ... for measuring the fluency of the output sentences.
